01

Getting Started

What is a residential proxy?+

A residential proxy forwards connection requests through an IP address on a residential network. Its network origin differs from a datacenter endpoint. This does not guarantee successful access or remove the need to follow the target service access rules.

What services does REDROCK offer?+

REDROCK offers rotating residential, static residential, mobile and datacenter proxies. Products address different network, session and task requirements. Review the product types, then confirm available locations, setup options and billing details.

Explore Proxy Products ↗
What can proxies be used for?+

Common uses include researching public market information, checking ad displays, observing search results and authorized website or application testing. Ensure you have appropriate access to the target content and follow applicable laws and service terms.

How can I tell whether a product suits my needs?+

List the locations, expected usage, task frequency, session duration and protocols you need. Check each against the product settings and run a small test in your workflow before increasing usage.

02

Products and Configuration

How do rotating and static residential proxies differ?+

Rotating residential proxies change IPs according to their settings. Static residential proxies suit workflows that need a relatively fixed network endpoint. Rotation rules, IP allocation, service periods and session duration depend on the selected product.

Should I choose mobile or datacenter proxies?+

Mobile proxies connect through mobile networks for tasks such as checking mobile experiences or testing applications. Datacenter proxies use datacenter networks for automation and routine data access. Choose based on the target service, network requirements and test results.

Can I choose an endpoint by country or city?+

Products include location selection settings. Available countries, regions and cities can vary by product. Check the relevant product page or console for current options; options available for one product may not apply to others.

How long do sessions last? Will the IP stay the same?+

Session persistence and IP rotation are separate settings. Their behavior depends on the product and selected parameters. If you need the same endpoint over time, confirm session duration, service period and conditions that may cause changes before purchasing.

03

Purchasing and Billing

Where can I find current prices?+

Check the pricing page and product checkout for prices, billing units, included usage and validity periods. Billing methods vary by proxy type, so review these conditions together when comparing plans.

View Billing Details ↗
Which payment methods are available?+

Use the payment options shown at checkout. For business purchasing or specific payment arrangements, contact support before ordering to confirm available methods and requirements.

Are refunds available after purchase?+

The published refund policy states that refunds are not offered due to the nature of proxy services. Confirm the product settings, billing method and current service terms before purchasing. Contact support to investigate order, billing or usage issues.

What should I provide for a billing or order question?+

Include your account email, order number, purchase time and a description of the charges or usage in question. Do not send account passwords, API keys or complete proxy credentials through the inquiry form or regular email.

Contact support ↗
04

Technical Setup

Which proxy protocols are supported?+

Setup options include HTTP(S) and SOCKS5. Confirm the protocols available for your product and make sure the client, proxy address, port and authentication method match.

How do I generate or obtain proxy credentials?+

Sign in to the console and open the relevant proxy product. Select the location, session settings and connection format to obtain setup details. Options vary by product. Keep credentials secure and out of public code or screenshots.

Are connection speed or success rates guaranteed?+

Performance depends on endpoint location, the target service, network quality, task frequency and client settings. Test with actual tasks. If you require specific service metrics, confirm any applicable written service agreement before purchasing.

What should I check when a connection fails?+

Check the protocol, proxy address and port, authentication details and product availability first. Then troubleshoot with a small test request. When contacting support, include the error time, sanitized error details, client and selected location. Do not send complete credentials.
